steps.say: A whole row is the way in. Tapping anywhere on it opens that class, and the keyboard works too.
The class page opens on its roster, which is where most of what you want to do with a class lives.
The buttons at the right of the row do their own jobs and do not open the class.
steps.terminal: That's opening a class — tap the row, land on the roster. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
